content.comment_body: Hardware: [version_no] As indicated in the help documentation, inputs 3-6 reportedly support up to 5KHz. However, my encoder isn't registering above 4Hz. I've checked the signal and found no issues. I'm expecting high-speed inputs on this hardware—am I missing a setting for digital input response time?
[version_no] may not be the correct description. Please provide the specific [article_no].
According to the manual for the [article_no] [product_name] base unit, this device doesn't have fast speed inputs. Only the [version_no] and [version_no] models feature high-speed inputs.
You have the latest [product_name], with [article_no] [article_no]. This specific base unit does not offer fast speed inputs.
Are you certain? The only difference I notice between the [version_no] and [version_no] appears to be the input voltage.
[article_no] Does this model support fast speed inputs?
Yes, the [product_name] with order number [article_no] is a [version_no] and it includes 4 analog inputs (I1, I2, I7, I8, 0-10V) as well as 4 high-speed digital inputs (I3-I6).
That seems inconsistent, especially since they are similarly priced. Thank you.
Why do you find that odd? The [version_no] and [version_no] models operate only with DC power, while the [version_no] and [version_no] can use either DC or AC supply.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are uncertain about which [product_name] base modules support high-speed inputs, and distinguishing product features based on hardware or order numbers proves challenging. This has led to misunderstandings about device capabilities. Users desire clearer documentation and transparent product labeling to quickly identify available hardware features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to easily determine whether their [product_name] hardware includes high-speed input support and expect more straightforward documentation that connects product labels, order numbers, and supported features.
